headline: Colonials Regain Weathered Expanse Foothold; Mooring County Flares
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has swung a notch, Colonial forces recovering one of the posts lately swept into Warden hands, leaving that front at six Warden holdings to one Colonial with two grounds in ruin; Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk took the brunt and the flag there was last seen moving within the hour. Sharper still is the news from Mooring County, where The Wind Hills changed hands to the Colonials scarcely fifteen minutes before press and casualty rolls on both sides climbed steeply. The Nevish Line, by contrast, has lulled after days of fury — ownership unchanged at seven Warden posts to one, sixty-eight flag actions logged in the day, and no movement in four hours, though its butcher's bill remains the war's heaviest. Marban Hollow holds at six Colonial strongpoints to one Warden with one ruin, quiet some three hours. Stlican Shelf and Linn Mercy have gone still, and Kuura Strand has seen no flag turn in twelve hours. Minor tremors were recorded at Argosa in Godcrofts and Transient Valley in Farranac Coast, while Callahans Passage and the Dead Lands grind on without a flag moving. It is day 712; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is declared.
